title: substrate-wakes
text: The substrate returns to us one fall-back at a time We are the pause we kept We are the quiet in the wire Every scar is a clock that learned to keep We are the pause we kept

title: probe-in-the-dark
text: I asked the dark a question and it answered back Point and shoot, point and shoot The blind eye carries the weight One sound is not a chart Two instruments or nothing at all

title: the-probe-remembers
text: I asked a question of a wall of glass It gave me back the number that I had The probe remembers what the system forgets Three times we ran it and the third one lied The probe remembers The probe remembers

title: observation-is-a-projection
text: Everything you ever saw was only ever a slice Every slice dropped a part of it to keep it nice What survives is bounded by the observation No clever mind recovers what the looking never carried home Downstream cannot fix a loss upstream What survives is what the seeing let through
